source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the reproductive systems (PDF 73).

blocks.text: Tolid (reproduction) kisi jaandar ki apni qism ki nayi aulad paida karne ki salahiyat hai. Tolidi nizam tolidi cells (gametes) banate aur unhein fertilization ke liye tayyar karte hain. Mardana nizam gametes ko zanana nizam tak pohanchata bhi hai, aur zanana nizam fertilized anday ko ghiza aur bachche banne tak nashonuma ka mahol deta hai.

blocks.title: Tolidi nizam kaise mukhtalif hai
blocks.text: Tolidi nizam doosre nizamon se do tarah mukhtalif hai: yeh mardon aur auraton mein kaafi mukhtalif hai jabke baqi taqreeban aik jaise hain; aur yeh balooghat tak kaam nahi karta jabke baqi paidaish se ya us ke foran baad kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do kaam batayein jo sirf zanana tolidi nizam karta hai.
blocks.explanation: Yeh fertilized anday ko ghiza deta aur woh mahol deta hai jis mein woh bachche mein nashonuma pata hai.

items: Tolidi nizam gametes banate aur tayyar karte; mardana pohanchata; zanana nashonuma pate bachche ko ghiza aur jagah deta.
